entries.summary: Added client-side pagination to [oha_vendor_status_table] shortcode
entries.notes: The vendor status table was loading all vendor applications at once, causing the view to be cut off when embedded in an iframe. Added JavaScript-driven pagination to vendor-status-table.php. All rows are still rendered to the DOM by PHP; JS shows only the current page slice. Pagination integrates with the existing search filter (resets to page 1 on new query, shows filtered count) and the existing column sort (re-orders DOM rows then re-renders current page). Default 20 rows per page, configurable via shortcode attribute: [oha_vendor_status_table per_page="25"]. Pagination bar shows First/Prev/numbered window/Next/Last buttons; scrolls widget top into view on page change (works correctly inside iframes). Count label updates to show e.g. 'Showing 21-40 of 87 vendor applications'.

entries.summary: Added Bulk Email Vendors panel to [oha_vendor_boardhub] shortcode using JEmail
entries.notes: New 'Bulk Email Vendors' button appears in the board hub controls bar. Clicking it opens a collapsible panel with: vendor status checkboxes for targeting (Submitted/Approved/Agreement Sent/Agreement Signed/Paid), live recipient count via AJAX, subject line input, TinyMCE rich text editor with full toolbar (bold/italic/underline/link/lists/blockquote/colour), and a Queue & Send button. Sending is non-blocking: the AJAX handler creates a JEmail campaign, queues all matching recipients, then returns immediately without calling process_batch(). This prevents the page freeze that occurred when wp_mail() was called synchronously in a loop. Batches process via WP Cron and JEmail's maybe_process_on_load. The panel polls campaign status every 8 seconds and shows live sent/queued counts. Requires JEmail Bulk Sender plugin to be active. Includes vendors without WP accounts (matched by email meta on vendor_application CPT). Unsubscribed addresses are automatically excluded. New AJAX actions: oha_vh_bulk_email_count, oha_vh_bulk_email_vendors, oha_vh_bulk_email_status. New helper: oha_vh_get_vendor_emails_by_status(). wp_enqueue_editor() added to wp_enqueue_scripts for manage_options users so TinyMCE is available on the frontend. Merge tags available: {{first_name}} {{last_name}} {{display_name}} {{email}} {{site_name}} {{unsubscribe_url}}.

entries.summary: Renamed zip and folder to match CLAUDE.md naming standard
entries.notes: Previous zip was oha-vendor-hub-v3.1.2-BOARD-HUB-COMPATIBLE.zip with folder vendor-hub-v3.1.2-FIXED/. New zip is vendor-hub-oha-v3.2.0.zip with folder oha-vendor-hub/ as required by CLAUDE.md plugin naming conventions.

entries.summary: Added Fast-Track Vendor Invite panel to [oha_vendor_boardhub] shortcode
entries.notes: New 'Fast-Track Invite' button (green) appears in the board hub controls bar alongside the Bulk Email button. Clicking it opens a panel with an optional vendor name field and a required email address field. Submitting sends a professional HTML-ready plain-text invitation email via wp_mail() to the specified address. The email includes event details (venue, dates, load-in time), a warm personal greeting (using the name if provided), and a direct link to the final vendor application page. The final application URL is read from the oha_vhcpt_final_app_page_id WP option if set, falling back to the hardcoded page URL. New AJAX action: oha_vh_fasttrack_invite (nonce: oha_vh_fasttrack_invite). On success the fields are cleared and a green confirmation bar appears. Does not create a vendor_application post -- this is purely an outbound invite.

entries.summary: Security audit fixes: XSS, post_type validation, Stripe email cross-check, signature MIME check
entries.notes: Four security fixes applied after audit. (1) Stored XSS in showVendorDetailsModal() JS: all user-supplied values (company name, contact fields, product type, history) were inserted into innerHTML without escaping. Added escHtml() helper function and applied to all user data in the modal template. Email href validated against strict regex before use. (2) oha_get_vendor_details AJAX: added get_post_type() check to reject requests for non-vendor_application post IDs, preventing meta data from arbitrary posts from being returned to admin users. (3) Stripe webhook: when client_reference_id resolves a vendor application, the Stripe customer email is now cross-checked against the stored vendor email; mismatches are logged as warnings but payment is still processed. (4) final-application.php signature_data: added regex MIME check (must be data:image/png or jpeg/jpg;base64,...) to prevent SVG or other executable-content MIME types from being stored and embedded into HTML agreements.

entries.summary: Relaxed two security fixes that were too strict and could break legitimate use
entries.notes: Two fixes from v3.3.1 were refined. (1) Stripe webhook email cross-check was changed from hard rejection to warning-only. client_reference_id is the authoritative identifier set server-side; vendors can legitimately change their email in the Stripe checkout form. Mismatch is now logged but does not block payment processing. (2) Signature MIME validation was expanded to accept jpeg/jpg in addition to png, since some signature pad library configurations output JPEG. The regex also allows optional \r\n characters for base64 line-break compatibility.

entries.summary: rawurlencode company/email in emailed app links so spaces do not break URL
entries.notes: add_query_arg() does not encode values; company names with spaces truncated the URL in plain-text emails, stripping no_payment_mode=1 and other params. Fixed by applying rawurlencode() to company and email before passing to add_query_arg().

entries.summary: Store _is_pre_paid meta on vendor app when no-payment email is sent
entries.notes: Now the form checks _is_pre_paid post meta (in addition to URL param) to bypass Stripe. Immune to URL parameter loss regardless of how vendor navigates to the form.

entries.summary: Add no_payment_mode hidden field to form and preserve it on error redirect
entries.notes: Hidden field ensures no_payment_mode survives POST submission. Error redirect now includes no_payment_mode=1 so retries after validation failure still bypass payment.

entries.summary: Fix [oha_vendor_final_form_no_payment] shortcode calling non-existent function
entries.notes: Replaced call to undefined oha_vendor_final_form_shortcode() with do_shortcode(oha_vendor_final_form). Shortcode was broken and would fatal error if oha_vhcpt_final_app_no_payment_page_id was configured.

entries.summary: Added [oha_vendor_cards] shortcode: public vendor card grid for website pages, light theme, responsive
entries.notes: 3-col desktop, 2-col tablet, 1-col mobile. Queries Paid vendors A-Z. Shows logo, name, product type, website. No favorites button.

entries.summary: Added admin settings for [oha_vendor_cards]: field visibility checkboxes and placeholder image picker
entries.notes: Options: oha_vhcpt_cards_fields (website, products), oha_vhcpt_cards_placeholder_id, oha_vhcpt_cards_placeholder_url. WP media picker with live preview. Located in Vendor Hub Settings > Vendor Card Grid section.

entries.summary: Added two-layer webhook guard to prevent membership payments marking vendor as Paid
entries.notes: Layer 1: if client_reference_id is present but not a vendor_application post, return false immediately. Layer 2: email fallback restricted to Agreement Signed status only via new oha_vhcpt_find_agreement_signed_app_by_email() in payment-tracking.php.

entries.summary: Added admin status override UI with confirmation modal on board hub admin shortcode
entries.notes: Override dropdown + styled confirmation modal in each card Quick Actions. Clears all payment markers when reverting from Paid. Live DOM updates stat counters and status badges. Appended to audit history log.

entries.summary: Added [oha_vendor_edit] shortcode with email magic link for vendor self-service profile updates
entries.notes: Vendors enter email on edit page to receive a 24-hour magic link. Logged-in users bypass the email step. Editable fields: contact info, address, website, product type (locked after Agreement Signed), logo upload. Token stored as _edit_token + _edit_token_expires post meta. Rate-limited to 5 min per email via transient.

entries.summary: Added Update Your Vendor Info button to vendor dashboard when edit page option is configured
entries.notes: Only shows if oha_vhcpt_vendor_edit_page_id WP option is set. Set this to the page ID containing [oha_vendor_edit] to activate the link.

entries.summary: Added applications closed toggle to Vendor Hub Settings with customizable message
entries.notes: oha_vhcpt_apps_closed (0/1) controls whether [oha_vendor_form] shows the form or a closed notice. oha_vhcpt_apps_closed_message holds the displayed text. Toggle is at the top of the Settings page under Application Status.

entries.summary: Moved Stripe webhook URL display from admin notice to Vendor Hub Settings page
entries.notes: Was showing as a notice-info banner on every vendor_application admin screen on page load. Now a static read-only field in Settings > Stripe Webhook section.

entries.summary: Removed 5 noisy error_log calls from stripe-webhook.php that fired on every Stripe event
entries.notes: Removed: Processing payment event header, Event type, Payment for email (all fired on every Stripe event including memberships). Removed: No vendor application found (fired on every non-vendor payment). Removed: Processing complete (redundant). Kept all exception and failure logs.

entries.summary: Add Vendor Edit Page selector to settings UI so admin can configure page without code
entries.notes: oha_vhcpt_vendor_edit_page_id now has a page dropdown in Application Status section of settings. Previously required manual option set.

entries.summary: Correct OHA_VHCPT_VER constant which was stuck at 3.5.0 since v3.7.0 bumps
entries.notes: PHP header was correct at 3.7.0 but constant was missed during v3.6.0 and v3.7.0 bumps. Now both updated to 3.7.1.

entries.summary: Set status note text to black so it is readable on tan notification background
entries.notes: oha-vh-status-note in vendor-edit.php inline styles. Scoped to that element only.

entries.summary: Set form field labels to white in vendor edit form for readability on red background
entries.notes: Added .oha-vh-edit-wrap .oha-vh-row label { color:#fff; } in vendor-edit.php inline styles. Scoped to edit wrap only so intake form labels are unaffected.

entries.summary: Added Send Edit Links admin page under Vendor Applications with status filter, count, send, and test email buttons
entries.notes: New file: includes/admin/send-edit-links.php. Submenu: Vendor Applications > Send Edit Links. Generates a real 24h token per vendor, sends via wp_mail directly. Test email goes to current admin email using first vendor record on file.

entries.summary: Added editable edit link email subject and body fields to Vendor Hub Settings
entries.notes: New WP options: oha_vhcpt_edit_link_subject, oha_vhcpt_edit_link_body. Saved in Application Status section of settings-page.php. Supports {first_name} and {link} placeholders.

entries.summary: Updated oha_vh_send_edit_link() to read subject/body from options and support {first_name} and {link} placeholders
entries.notes: Function signature now accepts optional  param. Default body changed from You requested a link to Here is a link. Call site in magic-link flow updated to pass first_name from post meta.

entries.summary: Removed product_type lock from vendor edit form so vendors can update their description at any status
entries.notes: Previously locked when status was Agreement Signed or Paid. Lock removed from save logic and form display. Status note banner also removed.

entries.summary: Restructured vendor form into public/private sections with field hints, badges, and logo callout notice
entries.notes: Sections: Business Information (public badge), Contact Information (board only badge), Convention Details, Booth Preference, Note to Board. Logo notice explains to upload after approval.

entries.summary: Added private notes field to vendor form for vendor-to-board messages
entries.notes: Saves as vendor_private_notes meta. Shown in board hub modal as yellow callout when present. Board-only, never public.

entries.summary: Added returning vendor checkbox and booth preference textarea to vendor form
entries.notes: Saves returning_vendor (bool) and booth_preference meta. Both shown in board hub modal Booth section. Callout box explains returning vendors get first pick.

entries.summary: Website field now normalizes URLs on save - strips junk chars and prepends https:// if protocol missing
entries.notes: Handles copy-paste artifacts: smart quotes, zero-width spaces. Uses esc_url_raw after normalization. Facebook links and partial URLs both handled.

entries.summary: Added Convention Details section to Vendor Hub Settings - name, venue, dates, load-in, booth price
entries.notes: Five options: oha_vhcpt_convention_name/venue/dates/load_in/booth_price. Update at start of each year. Fields omitted from emails if left blank.

entries.summary: Fast-track invite and approval emails now pull venue and dates from Convention Details settings instead of hardcoded 2026 values
entries.notes: Both emails fully dynamic. Hardcoded Mansfield Reformatory/May 9-10 2026 references removed. Plugin description also de-year-stamped.

entries.summary: Private notes, returning vendor flag, and booth preference now displayed in board hub vendor detail modal
entries.notes: returning_vendor and booth_preference added to oha_get_vendor_details AJAX response and showVendorDetailsModal JS.

entries.summary: Added convention year stamping on new vendor applications via active year setting
entries.notes: _convention_year meta stamped on submit using oha_vhcpt_active_year option. Set in Settings > Convention Details.

entries.summary: Added _vendor_permanent_id meta to all new applications using post ID as permanent cross-year ID
entries.notes: Assigned on form submit. Carried forward by return invite tool when creating new-year applications.

entries.summary: Added {vendor_id} merge tag to all automated email templates
entries.notes: Resolves to _vendor_permanent_id meta, falls back to post ID if not set.

entries.summary: Added year filter dropdown and VID display to Board Hub vendor card view
entries.notes: Filter by _convention_year meta. VID-xxx shown on card header and in details modal.

entries.summary: Added Year Tools admin page with backfill tool and return vendor invite tool
entries.notes: Backfill stamps _convention_year and _vendor_permanent_id on all existing untagged posts. Return invite tool finds prior-year Paid vendors with no current-year app, creates pre-populated drafts, sends 7-day magic-link invite emails.

entries.summary: Added Active Convention Year field to Convention Details settings section
entries.notes: Controls what year is stamped on new submissions. Update each season before opening applications.

entries.summary: Year Tools: return invite tool now accepts explicit target year instead of relying on settings active year
entries.notes: Added target_year field to UI and AJAX. Removed validation that blocked from_year >= active_year. Both years are now fully user-controlled on the tool page.

entries.summary: Board hub year filter: register vh_year as WP query var to prevent canonical redirect stripping it
entries.notes: WordPress strips unknown GET params via canonical redirect. Added query_vars filter for vh_year. Switched to get_query_var() with  fallback.

entries.summary: Board hub year filter: default to active convention year instead of showing all vendors
entries.notes: When no year is selected, defaults to oha_vhcpt_active_year. Selecting All Years now uses value=all to explicitly override the default.

entries.summary: Board hub filter forms now preserve ?tab= param so the active Board Hub tab is not lost on submit
entries.notes: Added hidden tab input to search and year filter forms. Reads current_tab from get_query_var/GET.

entries.summary: Removed hardcoded oha_vendor_board_hub convention_2026 tab hooks from Board Hub integration
entries.notes: Tab is now added manually via Board Hub Settings tab manager. Use shortcode [oha_vendor_boardhub].

entries.summary: tables_needed and need_electric required fields added to public intake form
entries.notes: Both fields validated server-side. need_electric is yes/no radio. tables_needed is integer input.

entries.summary: Logo upload moved into initial intake form with live preview and public badge
entries.notes: Reuses oha_vh_handle_logo_upload from vendor-edit.php. Removed deferred logo notice callout.

entries.summary: Vendor card grid filtered by active convention year only
entries.notes: Reads oha_vhcpt_active_year option. Prevents 2026 paid vendors showing in 2027 grid.

entries.summary: Separate 2-booth Stripe payment link support via oha_vh_get_stripe_payment_link() helper
entries.notes: New options: oha_vhcpt_stripe_link_test_2booth and oha_vhcpt_stripe_link_live_2booth. Falls back to 1-booth link if unset.

entries.summary: year attribute added to [oha_vendor_status_table] for year-specific filtering
entries.notes: Usage: [oha_vendor_status_table year=2027]. Heading updates to show year when filtered.

entries.summary: Return Invite tool now copies logo, tables_needed, and booth_preference from prior year
entries.notes: Added _company_logo_id, _company_logo_url, tables_needed, and booth_preference to copy_keys array.

entries.summary: Replace dangerous email meta overwrite in PDF test handler with get_post_metadata filter
entries.notes: Old code used update_post_meta to swap email then restore - risky if exception thrown mid-call. New code uses a closure filter on get_post_metadata to intercept the read without touching DB.

entries.summary: Remove dead [oha_test] debug shortcode (no cap check, public-facing)
entries.notes: Was registered in final-application.php with no capability check. Removed entirely. See memory/project_vendor_hub_removed_code.md for rollback.

entries.summary: Add 3-second transient rate limit to oha_send_vendor_email and oha_send_final_app_email AJAX handlers
entries.notes: Prevents accidental email floods from rapid admin clicks. Per-user transient key: oha_vh_email_throttle_{user_id}.

entries.summary: Add shortcode reference panel to Vendor Hub Settings page
entries.notes: Lists all 8 shortcodes with access level, description, meta keys used, attributes, and dependencies. Includes legacy alias table.

entries.summary: Email subject placeholder in bulk email panel now reads from oha_vhcpt_convention_name option
entries.notes: Previously hardcoded OHA Convention 2026 in the placeholder text.

entries.summary: Year dropdown always shows active convention year even when no applications exist yet
entries.notes: Active year injected into year_rows via array_unshift if not already present. Default filter now always uses active_year unconditionally (removed the empty year_rows check).

entries.summary: Empty state message for active year is now actionable with next-step instructions
entries.notes: When viewing the active year with no vendors, shows guidance to run Return Vendor Invites in WP Admin instead of generic no vendors found.
